text:
amanda: FYI — after the RBAC refactor and today's VPC allowlist rollout, onprem bastion logins to the private control plane in eu-west-1 are failing for admin users. Seeing 403s.

jay: I'm getting `403 Forbidden` when trying to list clusters via `rctl list`.

claire: also hit a KMS decrypt error when running the infra CI for a customer: `AccessDeniedException: Caller is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt`.

marta: timeline — VPC allowlist change at 09:10, RBAC migration script ran at 09:22, terraform apply at 09:35. Could be the migration renaming roles.

amanda: @tony can you check whether `onprem_admin` bindings were renamed to `priv_admin` by the migration? If so the allowlist may still be keyed to the old role name.

tony: checking logs now. I see the migration did a rename: `onprem_admin -> private_admin_v2`.

jay: that matches the 403s — policy that maps allowlisted roles to bastion session grants uses exact role name. We didn't include the new `private_admin_v2` in that mapping.

raghav: KMS issue might be related — KMS key policy references principal `arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/onprem_admin`. If role name changed, decrypt will fail.

claire: attaching minimal log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T09:37:12Z rctl error: api.v1.clusters.list -> status=403 user=arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/private_admin_v2
2026-03-20T09:37:15Z kms.Decrypt error: AccessDeniedException PrincipalNotInPolicy arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/private_admin_v2
```

marta: agreed cause = migration renamed role but we didn't update allowlist mapping or KMS policies. :facepalm: 

amanda: short-term mitigation: re-add `onprem_admin` as a delegated role in the allowlist mapping and add it to KMS key policy, then rotate to canonicalize names in a follow-up. Who can apply the emergency patch?

tony: I can push the allowlist mapping hotfix and update the KMS key policy (will need quick approval). Will make changes in eu-west-1 first.

raghav: I'll prepare the KMS policy patch and test decrypts with a non-prod mirror, then coordinate approval with security.

security-bot: Incident ticket created #INC-2026-093 — label: onprem-rbac-kms. Pager duty alerted.

amanda: OK. Plan: (1) Tony applies allowlist hotfix (2) Raghav updates KMS key policy (3) run smoke tests on staging (4) gradual rollback of role aliases and plan for rename reconciliation. @marta please own postmortem and add migration check to preflight.

marta: will do. I'll collect audit logs and draft a short postmortem. Expect initial update in 1h.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: `allowlist-hotfix-eu-west-1` by tony — job id d-7821. ETA ~12m.

jay: ping once done so I can validate cluster access.

amanda: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
